name: Tomislav Furlanis
backstory: LOTR and Greg Bear's Eon started my reading adventures at the age of nine and high school sparked my first PC game design attempts. Two decades followed absorbed in Forgotten Realms, TTRPGs, and Extra Credits. Now, armed with research in narrative and design theories, doctoral degree in humanities and packed insights from the real and fictional worlds, I stand ready to work on board games. For me they are a profound art uniquely expressing embodied human relations beyond any other medium.
